_about: Ready-made empires. Each copies a base-game prescripted empire (template) for a valid government, species and ruler, then takes its own names, origin and ship look. ship_look is a graphical culture from a Workshop shipset mod (mod = its Workshop id); without that mod the game falls back to a base-game look.

empires.name: United Federation of Planets
empires.desc: An alliance of worlds devoted to exploration, science and peaceful coexistence, defended by Starfleet.

empires.name: Klingon Empire
empires.desc: A warrior empire ruled by its Great Houses, where honor is won in battle.

empires.name: Romulan Star Empire
empires.desc: A secretive, calculating empire that prefers the cloak and the dagger to open war.

empires.name: Cardassian Union
empires.desc: A resource-starved military state where the Central Command and the Obsidian Order rule in the name of order.

empires.name: The Dominion
empires.desc: An ancient empire of the Gamma Quadrant. Its Founders are worshipped as gods by the peoples they engineered to serve them.

empires.name: Ferengi Alliance
empires.desc: A commercial power that lives by the Rules of Acquisition. Everything has a price.

empires.name: Borg Collective
empires.desc: One mind, countless drones. Resistance is futile.

empires.name: Confederacy of Vulcan
empires.desc: A people who mastered their passions through logic and turned to science.

empires.name: Terran Empire
empires.desc: The mirror universe's Earth: conquest, betrayal and the agonizer booth.

empires.name: Galactic Empire
empires.desc: The New Order: one Emperor, one fleet of Star Destroyers, and fear to keep the systems in line.

empires.name: Rebel Alliance
empires.desc: The Alliance to Restore the Republic: a scattered fleet and a great deal of hope.

empires.name: Galactic Republic
empires.desc: A thousand generations of democracy, guarded by the Jedi and the Grand Army.

empires.name: Confederacy of Independent Systems
empires.desc: Corporate guilds and breakaway systems with droid armies and deep pockets.

empires.name: Mandalorian Clans
empires.desc: Clans of armored warriors united by a creed. This is the way.

empires.name: Sith Empire
empires.desc: The ancient enemy of the Jedi, returned from the Unknown Regions to claim the galaxy.

empires.name: Zann Consortium
empires.desc: A criminal syndicate with a navy. Corruption is its sharpest weapon.

empires.name: Imperium of Man
empires.desc: A million worlds held together by faith, fear and the Astartes. There is only war.

empires.name: Adeptus Mechanicus
empires.desc: The priesthood of Mars, keepers of all knowledge and servants of the Omnissiah.

empires.name: Forces of Chaos
empires.desc: Traitor legions and the lost and the damned, pouring out of the Eye of Terror.

empires.name: Necron Dynasties
empires.desc: Soulless metal legions waking after sixty million years to reclaim what was theirs.

empires.name: Tyranid Hive Fleet
empires.desc: The Great Devourer. It does not hate you. It is simply hungry.

empires.name: Tau'ri
empires.desc: The people of Earth, who opened the Stargate and found the galaxy waiting. Base-game technology tree for now.

empires.name: Wraith Hives
empires.desc: The hunters of the Pegasus galaxy, who feed on the living. Base-game technology tree for now.

empires.name: Followers of the Ori
empires.desc: Hallowed are the Ori. Base-game technology tree for now.

empires.name: Lantean Remnant
empires.desc: The Ancients, builders of the Stargates. Base-game technology tree for now.

empires.name: Earth Defense Force
empires.desc: Humanity's last fleet, led by the space battleship Yamato. Base-game technology tree for now.
